title: Grandma's Recipe Card
story:
Nora found an old recipe card while she was cleaning a drawer in the spare room. The card was faded, and one corner was bent. Grandma's handwriting was small but clear. The title said "Sunday lentil stew". She remembered the smell of that stew on cold evenings when she was a child.

The card listed each ingredient in order. There were lentils, carrots, onion, garlic, and a tin of tomatoes. A note at the bottom said to add a pinch of cumin near the end. Nora was not sure about cumin, so she checked the spice jar in the kitchen. The smell was warm, and she decided the stew was worth a try.

She followed the card step by step. She rinsed the lentils and cut the vegetables into chunks. Then she warmed oil in a heavy pot and cooked the onion until it was soft. The tomatoes made the mixture red and thick. Nora let it bubble gently and stirred so nothing stuck. After forty minutes the lentils were tender. It was not exactly Grandma's stew, but it was close. The pinch of cumin made it warm and comforting. Nora copied the card into a fresh notebook so the words would not be lost. She put the old card back in the drawer, inside a clean envelope. Next month she planned to cook the stew for her father and tell him where she had found the instructions.
